items.title: Cohomology commutes with base change for a proper morphism if and only if acyclic injective test sheaves stay acyclic after base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a proper morphism f : X -> Y of schemes two conditions are equivalent: cohomology commutes with base change for f, and for every prime l, every injective sheaf I of Z/lZ-modules on X_etale and every base change diagram the sheaves R^q f'_*(g')^{-1}I vanish for q > 0 (statement lines 18359-18371). The proof (proof lines 18373-18428) gives one direction directly and reduces the converse in three steps: filtered colimits over torsion truncations, splitting off l-torsion via the long exact sequence, and an injective resolution combined with Leray's acyclicity lemma. H2: a three-step reduction with three independent inputs, all written out.
